comments.body: 2026-10-24: on main in 375c6d92. Only a state, session id, sub-agent change or --clear marks the adapter heard; a statusline-only Claude Code pane reads silent after a turn.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-17: no Claude Code session on this Mac loads Muster's plugin (`claude plugin list` has no muster entry and no running `claude` passes `--plugin-dir`), yet every Claude Code pane in `muster window` says `adapter: reporting`. The statusline's report is enough, since `adapter_heard` counts any report from the pane's agent.

So nothing tells the person the hooks are missing, which `silent` exists to do. Without them a pane's state comes only from its screen, `/clear` leaves the old context ring (a_2jSDHoYDD), and the daemon never hears a session id, so `pane restart` has nothing to resume (inferred from the code, not tried).

Likely fix: a statusline report alone (context, model, cost, session name) does not make the adapter `reporting`; a hook's report (`--state`, `--session-id`, `--subagent-*`) does. Then a pane with the statusline and no plugin reads `silent`, and `muster harness install claude` is the advice it already gets.
title: muster window says adapter reporting when only the statusline reports
